articles.title: IIM Rohtak hosts Management Conference 2026, brings together 50+ industry leaders to discuss future of business
articles.summary: The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Rohtak organised its Management Conference 2026 on October 24, bringing together over 50 industry leaders and academic experts to discuss emerging business challenges and changing management practices. The event featured keynote addresses and four panel discussions on innovation, finance, AI, future workplaces and career opportunities in the digital era..

articles.title: Patrick Stewart dies at 86 after battle with Alzheimer’s and Lewy body dementia
articles.summary: Sir Patrick Stewart, the celebrated British actor known for Star Trek: The Next Generation and the X-Men franchise, has died at 86 at his Los Angeles home, according to a family statement. His death follows a battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia.

articles.title: Kareena teases Mira on ‘third child’ rumour
